An '''adamant helmet''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], made by smithing a [[diamond helmet]] with [[adamant alloy]]. Adamant replaces netherite, and its armor carries the [[Doom]] intrinsic.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 3 armor, 3 toughness and 10% knockback resistance, the vanilla netherite values, with 1000 durability. Each piece also has Protection I and Unbreaking II.

=== Doom ===
The [[Doom]] intrinsic periodically clears Weakness from nearby creatures and deals armor-piercing damage as it does, so it combines with the Weakness from adamant weapons. Each piece strengthens it, and wearing all four adds the Doom [[set bonus]] as well as Absorption I (2 hearts) for 31 seconds every 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/divinity/adamant_armour.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_helmet.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows knockback resistance 1 (real value 0.1).

== History ==

{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added item textures.}}
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats. The set bonus was nerfed slightly.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by adamant armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Reworked: pieces gave Health Boost hearts and the set bonus 2 soul hearts. Durability lowered from 1500 to 1000.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The intrinsic was reworked into [[Doom]]. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
